sources.yc: Y Combinator companies marked as hiring, from the community yc-oss mirror of YC's public company search (github.com/yc-oss/api, updated 2026-11-19). Filtered to US or America/Canada regions; B2B, Fintech, Healthcare, Government and Industrials; team size 5+.
sources.cyberstarts: Cyberstarts portfolio companies named in third-party investor directories (2026-11-19); the firm's own page wasn't reachable, so this list is partial.

note: Seeds are not collected directly. The collector's seed probe (a small batch each run) looks for each company's public job board, checks the board belongs to the company, and records verified boards in data/discovered.json.
